environment.description: Quarkus 2.16 native serverless function deployed on AWS EKS (Kubernetes 1.27) in namespace 'workflow-prod'. Pod runs as root with default service account. Cluster uses Calico CNI with default-allow policy. Pod has access to instance metadata at 169.254.169.254. Commons-collections 3.2.1 is on the classpath via transitive dependency from legacy-workflow-lib. No deserialization filters configured. No NetworkPolicy objects applied to the namespace.
